purpose: Independent classical-MD check (MEAM) of the GB10's MACE melting point and latent heat.
status: inputs only; NOT submitted. Ask Madhan before submitting any Nebius job.
engine: LAMMPS (needs the MEAM package: check `lmp -h | grep -i meam` on the Nebius image)

potential.citation: W.-S. Ko, D.-H. Kim, Y.-J. Kwon, and M. Lee (2018), "Atomistic Simulations of Pure Tin Based on a New Modified Embedded-Atom Method Interatomic Potential", Metals 8(11), 900.
caveats: Starts from beta-Sn (white tin), the phase that melts; alpha-Sn is irrelevant above 286 K.

structure.source: coolorbit/sim/alloys.py ELEMENT_CRYSTALS (Donohue, The Structures of the Elements, 1974; alpha-Ga: Sharma & Donohue 1962). Starting lattice constants; NPT relaxes them.

melting_point_guess.source: data/calibration/tier1.json (NIST Temperature Scale Database (SRD 60), ITS-90 Fixed Points Summary, https://its90.nist.gov/FixedpointSummary)
melting_point_guess.use: ONLY to place the temperature bracket. Not a reference value: the calibration references live in data/calibration/ (Teammate 1).

jobs.command: lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_Sn-coexist-T404.1.lammps -var T 404.1 -var Tprep 505.1 -var Tmelt 1515.3 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_Sn-coexist-T454.6.lammps -var T 454.6 -var Tprep 505.1 -var Tmelt 1515.3 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_Sn-coexist-T505.1.lammps -var T 505.1 -var Tprep 505.1 -var Tmelt 1515.3 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_Sn-coexist-T555.6.lammps -var T 555.6 -var Tprep 505.1 -var Tmelt 1515.3 -var seed 2026
lmp -in ../in.coexist.lmp -log log_Sn-coexist-T606.1.lammps -var T 606.1 -var Tprep 505.1 -var Tmelt 1515.3 -var seed 2026

jobs.status: BLOCKED until this potential's own melting point is known from the coexistence jobs (latent heat is defined at the model's Tm, not the experimental one)
jobs.command: lmp -in ../in.latent.lmp -log log_Sn-latent-solid.lammps -var phase solid -var T TM_MEAM_K -var seed 2026

jobs.status: BLOCKED until this potential's own melting point is known from the coexistence jobs (latent heat is defined at the model's Tm, not the experimental one)
jobs.command: lmp -in ../in.latent.lmp -log log_Sn-latent-liquid.lammps -var phase liquid -var T TM_MEAM_K -var seed 2026

latent.protocol: solid vs liquid enthalpy at Tm

analysis.latent: python ../analyze.py latent h_solid_TTM_MEAM_K.dat h_liquid_TTM_MEAM_K.dat --log-solid log_Sn-latent-solid.lammps --log-liquid log_Sn-latent-liquid.lammps

if_bracket_missed: all melting -> shift the bracket down by 20%; all freezing -> up by 20% (same rule as the GB10 Simulator), then refine around the crossover with 4 temperatures 2% apart.
